title: Concept: Package manager config served with a token
description: An npmrc file that carries a registry token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The token can publish packages to the bank's scope, which turns a file read into a supply-chain write against every service that installs from that registry.
applicability: Deployments that render an npmrc file that carries a registry token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The token can publish packages to the bank's scope, which turns a file read into a supply-chain write against every service that installs from that registry.
